slides.texte_overlay:
How to get that
effortless movie-star charisma
Move slowly and smoothly. Rushed movements look nervous. Calm, deliberate gestures make you look confident and relaxed.
Let people come to you sometimes. Don't chase every conversation. A little mystery makes people curious about you. Not cold, just calm.
Smile like you mean it. A slow, genuine smile that reaches your eyes is more charming than any line. Practise it.
Be comfortable being watched. When people look at you, don't fidget or look away. Stay relaxed and keep doing your thing.
Before: I struggled to hold people's attention. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and my stories got much better.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I struggled to hold people's attention. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My stories got much better.

slides.texte_overlay: Have a simple signature style. A favourite jacket, good boots, a clean haircut. Consistency makes you recognisable.
Be warm with everyone. Real charisma isn't cool distance, it's making everyone around you feel at ease. Warmth wins.
